summary: Frontend-only verification of Point 41 (a,b,c,g,h,i,j) consumer PWA overhaul + static verification of Point 40 iOS iPad picker fix + backend regression for Points 38/39. Logged in on preview with reviewer phone 9999999999 / OTP 123456 (new user -> completed onboarding). 41a tagline, 41b tier badge gradient, 41c points-to-next-tier text, 41g complete-profile CTA (Interests removed), 41h Brands Directory + 4th Floor, 41i T&C chip + smooth scroll block, 41j referral section all render/work. TWO real defects found: (1) CRITICAL - the hero 'T&C' link navigates to /app/tier which is NOT a registered route (real route is /app/tier-journey), so the catch-all redirects the user back to /app/home; (2) the new Tier T&C block text is unreadable (dark text #2E2219 on dark #12141A card, contrast ~1.1:1). Also found a tier-threshold data inconsistency: Home hardcodes Silver at 500 pts ('You are 500 points away from Silver') while backend /api/consumer/tier-info returns next_at=2500 and the tier table on the Tier Journey page shows Silver from 2500.

ui_bugs.issue: navigate('/app/tier') is not a defined route (ConsumerApp.jsx line 234 registers 'tier-journey'); the catch-all Route path='*' redirects back to /app/home. Verified twice: clicking the chip and direct goto /app/tier both stay/return on /app/home. Fix to '/app/tier-journey'.

Bullet text colour rgb(46,34,25) on card background rgb(18,20,26) => contrast ~1.1:1, text is effectively invisible (see screenshot). Heading 'TIER TERMS & CONDITIONS' is gold and readable, the 5 bullets are not.

Hardcoded thresholds (Bronze<500) contradict live tier config; user sees 'You are 500 points away from Silver' on /app/home but the Tier Journey table + API say Silver starts at 2500. Should read thresholds from /api/consumer/tier-info.
Sub-line 'Add Date of Birth, Email, Address and earn +500 pts' renders in pale gold on the gold-tinted (rgba(212,175,55,0.18)) banner - very low contrast, barely legible on mobile. Title is fine.
Clicking Copy gives no visual confirmation (button text stays 'Copy', no toast). Cannot tell if clipboard write succeeded.

Pre-existing (not from this batch): several image requests fail - https://mall-engagement-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/banner-vipul-goyal.jpeg, banner-vivek-samtani.jpg and https://mall-engagement-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/api/uploads/brands/...cover.png (cross-preview hardcoded hosts, 404/failed). rca_of_the_issue: ConsumerApp.jsx registers the tier page as <Route path="tier-journey"> and a catch-all <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/app/home" replace/>}>. Home.jsx's new Point 41b T&C button navigates to the non-existent '/app/tier', so React Router matches the catch-all and silently sends the user back to Home - the failure is invisible (no error), which is why it looks like the click did nothing. Reproduce: login -> /app/home -> click [data-testid=tier-tnc-link] -> URL remains /app/home. Mitigation: use '/app/tier-journey' or register an alias route.
